questions.promptEn: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: He was ______ an accident last night.
The big tree is ______ the middle of the road.
She lost her bag and is ______ trouble now.
We parked the car ______ front of the house.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ①. 제안에 Yes, you can.은 어색하다. (답지 04)
questions.promptEn: 다음 중 짝지어진 대화가 어색한 것은?
choices: A: Let's play a board game together. B: Yes, you can.
A: How about picking up trash? B: Sounds good.
A: What about eating a sandwich? B: I'm not sure about that.
A: Why don't we go for a walk? B: That's a good idea.
A: What about planting some trees? B: Sounds good.

questions.promptEn:
선생님을 위해 깜짝 파티를 열면 어떨까?
보기: don't / a / throw / surprise / we / party / why / for / him

accept: My plan is to learn French.
